summary.text: On Arcavios, home to the Strixhaven university founded by the five elder dragons, students from many planes study the five mana dichotomies, among them the twins Rowan and Will Kenrith, Killian Lu and Zimone Wola.
The Oriq attack the campus, and Extus Narr infiltrates the Biblioplex and summons the Blood Avatar, which Rowan and Will bring under control at the cost of Extus's life and Will's leg.
Liliana Vess leads a coalition of professors and planeswalkers that defeats the Oriq and thwarts Kasmina's plot to destroy the omenpaths and disintegrate Arcavios.
